title: Upgrade Guava to fix CVE-2023-2976
description: The dependency scan of trade-intake reports Guava 20.0. FileBackedOutputStream creates temporary files with default permissions, so other users on a Unix host can read buffered data. Fixed in 32.0.0. The same upgrade also resolves CVE-2018-10237 and CVE-2020-8908.
acceptance_criteria: com.google.guava:guava is at version 33.7.2-jre in pom.xml
The dependency scan no longer reports CVE-2023-2976
The dependency scan reports no new findings compared with the scan before the change
No files under src/test are changed
No other dependencies are added, removed or changed
